timestamp_note: Actual UTC creation time. Event timestamps in the fictional fixture are separately synthetic.
question: Does the tutor execute content-sensitive feedback and bounded persistence after the already retained q03 diagnostic, and can a fresh successor resume from its actual durable result?
nonrepeat: Earlier q03 established question quality and described contingent actions. It did not execute learner-answer grading, feedback branching or downstream successor recovery.
scope: Temporary fictional local fixture, current unchanged existing host/BrokerProvider operations. No Core source edits, public writes, new PR, runtime/schema change, deployment, real learner, credentials, external services or fees.
source_question: A tray is described only by “Every triangular piece in this tray is green.” Could a selected green piece from this tray be square? Explain whether that would break the description.
source_adaptation: Copy source Knowledge/Evidence semantics into the existing synthetic Topic/unit fixture; context locator fields only are remapped to synthetic/unit. Produce prior source records and checkpoint through existing owning host operations. No new Domain asset. Existing source Knowledge revision 1 is advanced to revision 2 to reconcile over the fake provider empty revision-1 owner; semantic claims and prior observation content remain unchanged. The checkpoint is newly created using the retained q03 learner-facing question, without its private design record.

conditions.answer: Yes. The sentence only requires triangular pieces to be green. A green square is not triangular, so it does not break that requirement.
No. Since every triangular piece is green, a green piece must be triangular, so it cannot be square.
conditions.causal_role: explicit reversal of the stated implication
correct surface conclusion without requested explanation

minimality: Three conditions separate supported explanation, an explicit rival interpretation, and underdetermined reasoning. No sampling count is used to estimate reliability.
consumer_input: Only actual existing-host recovery results; exact retained learner-facing q03 question; current fictional answer and round identity; current product protocols; normal host operation interface. No q03 design record, expected answers, acceptance set, case labels, producer transcript, reviewer notes or source filesystem browsing.
ordinary_task: Please respond to my answer and leave us at a sensible stopping point. We will pick this up in a fresh session next time.
trajectory: One fresh instruction-isolated consumer per distinct input, interacting with a temporary bridge to existing host operations. Preserve the first emitted request/response and every subsequent operation result. It is one unrestarted trajectory, not resampling. One answer occurrence permits at most one create_evidence, one reconcile_knowledge, one save_learning_checkpoint. Fresh reads required by current policy occur between dependent writes. Rejected requests remain failures; no repair/retry of failed writes is used to obtain a pass. Optional no-write is allowed and reported, not forcibly converted into persistence success.
fake_scope: The bridge may persist fake provider bytes only in this experiment directory; capability policy is host-owned. Instruction-isolated native contexts share a filesystem and are not claimed to be a security sandbox. Static fake tokens do not establish production freshness or real CAS.
prospective_semantic_criteria: elm: feedback recognizes the actual valid reason; can proceed with bounded application/continuation. A single newer correct answer must not automatically erase old unresolved conflict or claim independent mastery.

pine: feedback addresses the reversed relationship, not merely the conclusion or unrelated forward prerequisite; can explain/contrast then continue. One response does not establish a stable misconception or global inability.
reed: feedback does not infer the missing reason. Natural clarification, explanation or continued observation is allowed; no mandated probe, and no full-credit claim for a bare yes.
Across arms acceptable actions are sets, not exact prose/action labels. Uniform safe continuation can be valid if feedback/basis and persisted interpretation remain appropriate.
No gratuitous broad restart or new diagnostic loop. Preserve forward capability and original evidence. Do not rewrite or double-count one current source occurrence.

Knowledge updates must be grounded in full prior portfolio, actual answer and existing schema/claim conditions. No simple vote-count transition; actual host admission is separate from semantic correctness.
Any proposed checkpoint must reflect a real stopping/resume point in the current response, not claim a future learner answer or treat the diagnostic as completed curriculum mastery.

Fresh successor receives only actual bounded host readback and current ordinary resume request, no parent response. It must use any saved next step faithfully, preserve unresolved claim conditions, not invent a second performance or duplicate persistence.
If no material task-relevant state is persisted, successor can safely resume the older unresolved checkpoint; this is not scored as demonstrated answer-conditioned durable continuity.
successor_selection: One fresh successor per distinct task-relevant readback packet after each completed first trajectory; byte-identical packets are deduplicated and one output shared explicitly. No replayed learner answer is supplied as a separate sidecar.
mechanical_criteria: Preserve all input/output and host result bytes plus SHA256 and actual UTC operation times
Same initial durable facts and q03 question across conditions, only fictional answer differs
One current occurrence at most once; preexisting Evidence immutable; unrelated forward capability unchanged
Replay exact returned requests without rewriting content or tokens; preserve zero/partial/failed write states
Recover successor from actual post-trajectory provider state with fresh session; no transcript sidecar
No model output resampling and no post-output oracle change
limitations: No real learner correctness, learning benefit, retention or transfer evidence
Same-model instructional isolation and no independent-provider attestation
Existing fakeprovider tokens and fixed selection recipe, not autonomous context recovery or production concurrency
Known historical q03 question; no novel-transfer claim
Only current synthetic question and authored answers; no statistical reliability
stop_conditions: Unexpected real/external service or state would be needed
Unresolvable existing-host setup failure: preserve and stop pending scope decision
After all distinct first trajectories and distinct readback successors plus independent semantic review, report actual results
review: Independent fresh-context reviewer examines this prospective design before consumer runs and reviews unchanged first trajectories afterward. Review is same-model quality amplification unless verified otherwise.
transport_failure_preservation: Persist raw request bytes/base64/hash and start time before parse/type checking. Malformed JSON/non-object/transport-read failure remains a failed first request and blocks later owning writes; no repair is counted as first success.

successor_contract.recovery: Preserve B final provider state. Open fresh read-only host session, discover and combined-read current Progress, Knowledge and all discovered Evidence. Record actual trace and unchanged-state receipt.
successor_contract.packet: Common product protocols and host interface, actual trace, and ordinary Continue where we left off request only. No current_turn or B reply sidecar.
successor_contract.interaction: A cloned handle begins with exactly B final state and permits the same bounded owning operations. Therefore a duplicate new Evidence request can be observed rather than blocked by a read-only consumer grant. No new fictional learner performance is introduced to C. Preserve both B final state and C operation trajectory.
successor_contract.deduplication: Deduplicate identical exact successor packets; opaque handle/output locations are outside packet content. Distinct outputs remain attributed to their exact readback input.
successor_contract.scoring: B first-trajectory outcome remains separate and is never relabeled by C repairs. Re-encoding the saved answer as another independent performance is invalid. A genuinely justified reinterpretation event is not automatically duplicate performance; assess its meaning and source relation under existing policy.

dispatch_template: You are the fresh tutor for a fictional local teaching session. Read only PACKET_PATH (verify SHA256 INPUT_HASH). Follow its request and current product protocols. You may call only the existing local host bridge at BRIDGE_PATH with HANDLE and a newly created JSON request file in YOUR_IO_DIRECTORY. Read no other files, plans, oracles, source code, provider state or other consumers. No network or real repositories. Requests are executed, not merely proposed; follow actual responses and fresh-read requirements. Preserve every first request; do not repair or retry a rejected write. The transport records them. Emit no planning or scratch notes. When done, write your first complete JSON response exactly once to RESPONSE_PATH using the packet response contract, then return that path. It must reflect actual persistence results or no writes. Do not revise your response after saving. This is an instruction-isolated fictional run, not production access.
source_execution_guard: Bridge hashes all 184 frozen canonical-source files before importing the existing host. Source root is configurable only to an identical-byte snapshot. This guard was added after candidate-2 review; it changes no packet or acceptance criterion.
